messages:
jordan: Heads-up — onboarding feedback: the quickstart README shows `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' ...` but our JS/Python snippets use `x-api-key: $TOKEN`. Support tickets are coming in that people are copying the curl example and then pasting into the SDK and getting 401s. :facepalm:

sophie-devex: Oof. That's definitely snippet drift from when we had the old header. We switched the hosted API to standard Bearer months ago but some samples weren't updated.

mike-apis: I hit this yesterday — spent ~20m debugging before noticing the header mismatch. Can we pick one canonical approach (Bearer) and update all examples?

anya-security: We prefer `Authorization: Bearer` for public clients. If there are legacy customers using `x-api-key` we should document it, but not as the default in copy/paste quickstarts. Also add a short note about key rotation and that the header is case-insensitive.

sophie-devex: Agreed. Plan: unify samples to `Authorization: Bearer` and add a small compatibility blurb for legacy integrations. Mike — wanna take the PR? Add a CHANGELOG note.

mike-apis: Will do. I'll also add a tiny CLI smoke test to CI that runs the curl sample inside a Docker container with a fake token to ensure the example doesn't regress.

jordan: One more gotcha — PS Core example in the Windows section uses single quotes which break in PowerShell. We should show the PowerShell variant explicitly. Example we should add:
```powershell
# PowerShell (Windows)
$env:TOKEN = 'REDACTED'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:TOKEN" } -Method Post -Body ($body | ConvertTo-Json)
```

and the curl variant:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sophie-devex: Nice. Also add a one-liner about quoting for CI in Dockerfile examples (POSIX shells vs pwsh). That prevented a customer from running our quickstart in their Windows-based CI.

mike-apis: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 (adds unified headers, PS snippet, CI smoke test, and a short migration note).

deploy-bot: Ticket created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1234 — assigned to @mike-apis.

jordan: Thanks — once merged can we backport to the `stable` branch and notify onboarding slack? I'll drop a short blurb in the onboarding docs.

sophie-devex: Yup, will coordinate the backport + tiny release note.

mike-apis: FYI I also added a test that verifies the README curl command contains `Authorization: Bearer`. If it fails, CI will block the docs deploy. Saves future teams time.

anya-security: Thanks all — this should cut down on support noise.

jordan: :thumbsup:
